```python
def distinctSubsequences(S):
    mod = 10**9 + 7
    subsequences = set()
    subsequences.add("")
    for c in S:
        new_subsequences = set()
        for sub in subsequences:
            new_subsequences.add(sub + c)
            new_subsequences.add(sub)
        subsequences = new_subsequences
    return len(subsequences) % mod
```
</solution>

This solution is efficient and straightforward. It uses a set to keep track of the subsequences and returns its size modulo 10^9 + 7. It has a time complexity of O(n^2) and a space complexity of O(n^2), where n is the length of the string S.
